profile: Large multidisciplinary practice, healthcare-heavy. Deep hospital book, a strong federal design-build record, and a seismic group — organised by discipline, which is why nobody here has ever been asked whether one person holds both.

projects.title: Meridian Regional Medical Center — Bed Tower
projects.narrative: Nine-storey inpatient bed tower delivered on an operating hospital campus, with phased tie-ins to the existing diagnostic and imaging suites.

projects.title: Veterans Outpatient Clinic Replacement
projects.narrative: Replacement outpatient clinic consolidating primary care, ambulatory surgery and specialty services onto a single federal campus.

projects.title: Northgate Children's — Surgical Platform Expansion
projects.narrative: Surgical platform expansion adding twelve operating rooms and a paediatric intensive care floor above an occupied hospital podium.

projects.title: Calder County Behavioral Health Campus
projects.narrative: Behavioral health campus with residential treatment, crisis stabilisation and outpatient counselling.

projects.title: Federal Courthouse Modernisation
projects.narrative: Courtroom modernisation and secure circulation reconfiguration in an occupied federal courthouse.

projects.title: Whitmore University Research Laboratory
projects.narrative: Wet and dry research laboratory building with vivarium, shared core instrumentation and a high-bay engineering annex.

projects.title: Army Medical Support Facility
projects.narrative: Medical logistics and troop clinic support facility delivered on an active installation.

projects.title: Valley Transit Maintenance and Storage Facility
projects.narrative: Light rail maintenance and storage facility with service bays, wheel truing and an operations control room.

projects.title: Meridian Cancer Treatment Pavilion
projects.narrative: Ambulatory oncology pavilion with linear accelerator vaults, infusion suites and clinical trials space.

projects.title: Naval Hospital Support Annex
projects.narrative: Support annex to a naval hospital: central sterile processing, pharmacy and staff facilities, built inside the existing perimeter.

projects.title: Calder Regional Water Reclamation Expansion
projects.narrative: Process train expansion and headworks replacement at a regional water reclamation plant.

projects.title: St. Aurelia Emergency Department Modernisation
projects.narrative: Emergency department expansion doubling treatment bays and adding a dedicated behavioral health observation unit.

projects.title: Restricted Federal Health Facility
projects.client: withheld under the programme access agreement
projects.narrative: Inpatient facility delivered under a restricted-access agreement; client, location and scope are not disclosable to a third party under any terms.

people.name: Dana Whitfield

people.name: Marcus Lin
people.bio: Structural lead for civic and transit work, specialising in seismic retrofit of occupied public buildings and lateral strengthening of existing frames.

people.name: Priya Raman
people.bio: Clinical planner for acute care and ambulatory work; leads functional programming for surgical, imaging and inpatient units.

people.name: Ben Osei
people.bio: Project manager for federal civic and higher-education delivery, including design-build courthouse and laboratory programmes.

people.name: Hana Sorensen
people.bio: Structural engineer for long-span floor framing and vibration criteria in laboratory and diagnostic imaging environments.

people.name: Tomas Reyes
people.bio: Mechanical lead for hospital infrastructure: central plant capacity, isolation room pressurisation and resilient power for critical care.

people.name: Ada Fenwick
people.bio: Design principal for ambulatory and behavioral health architecture, focused on daylight and wayfinding in treatment settings.

people.name: Grant Mueller
people.bio: Construction manager for federal design-build delivery on active installations, including medical logistics and support facilities.
